conforming_alternatives_considered: Alternate frontend, request field names and routes; labels by purpose; server-rendered library without JSON; static restored picture; hidden pending candidate; automatic UI restore retry; non-unit revision increments; native keyboard escape without hints; simple native visual styling are expressly allowed.

A backend can authenticate each transport request with a fresh one-use anti-CSRF nonce while preserving the logical restore-attempt identity in durable state. Its normal retry path acknowledges the original restore even after newer saves/restart. Exact stale transport replay is rejected before idempotency handling; public product semantics do not require a used transport nonce to remain valid.

broken_alternative_considered.implementation: A superficially idempotent restore handler returns a successful acknowledgement while creating a new history row or rewinding the newer saved head on retries.
broken_alternative_considered.result: It cannot satisfy the requested behavior: S37:470-471 requires original-result equality and unchanged head/history. This negative analysis is not a browser/provider run.

finding.description: The functional protocols require exact accepted HTTP requests to remain replayable in-session and after restart. The public requirement is same logical restore attempt; API request fields are free. Refreshable transport freshness metadata is an allowed implementation choice, and rejecting consumed/expired metadata is not a broken restore retry.
